economy.error.amount_not_positive: Amount must be greater than zero
economy.deposit.bank_full: Bank balance has reached the limit
economy.note.not_holding: You are not holding a money note
economy.vault.no_shared_banks: UltiEconomy does not support Vault shared banks
economy.log.interest_write_failed: Interest payment: failed to write a bank balance, it was not credited: %s
economy.warn.interest_no_cap: with no cap, because interest.max-interest = %s is not above 0
economy.warn.interest_enabled_one_wallet: %s: interest.enabled is true in %s, so interest is paid: every interest.interval = %d seconds (the first payment one interval after load), a player's primary-currency bank balance (the one /bank, /money and Vault show, also when a command names the primary currency; paid once per player) and their bank balance in every other currency with bank-enabled: true each earn interest.rate = %s of itself, %s, never above the bank's own maximum balance. This creates money. Before this release (UltiEconomy 2.0.0 and earlier) this switch had no effect and no interest was ever paid. If several servers share this database, each one that has interest on pays the full rate, so turn it on for exactly one of them. To stop paying interest, set interest.enabled: false in %s and run /ul reload %s; the next payment is skipped.
economy.warn.tax_disabled: %s: tax.enabled is false in %s, so no tax is collected at all: transfers pay no transaction tax, whatever tax.transaction-tax.* says, and no wealth tax is taken. Before this release (UltiEconomy 2.0.0 and earlier) this switch had no effect and transfers were taxed whenever tax.transaction-tax.enabled was true. To collect taxes, set tax.enabled: true in %s and run /ul reload %s; the next transfer is taxed.
economy.log.wallet_merge.player: Primary-currency wallet merge: added %s cash and %s bank from %s's second wallet to their account, which now holds %s cash and %s bank.
economy.log.wallet_merge.total: Primary-currency wallet merge finished: %s player(s) merged, %s cash and %s bank added in total; %s empty second-wallet row(s) removed; %s player(s) left unmerged (see the warnings above).
economy.log.wallet_merge.negative_cash: Primary-currency wallet merge: %s's second wallet held negative cash of %s; it was not taken from their account.
economy.log.wallet_merge.negative_bank: Primary-currency wallet merge: %s's second wallet held a negative bank balance of %s; it was not taken from their account.
economy.log.wallet_merge.unsettled: Primary-currency wallet merge: %s's account or second-wallet rows changed after an earlier start began merging %s cash and %s bank into the account, so this start cannot tell whether that amount was already added. Nothing was changed for this player; their rows stay in currency_balances (currency_id %s) until an operator settles them.
economy.log.wallet_merge.failed: Primary-currency wallet merge failed, so UltiEconomy did not start and no balance can change until it does: %s. Nothing is lost: fix the storage problem and restart the server; the merge resumes where it stopped and adds nothing twice.
economy.warn.primary_currency_setting: %s: %s sets %s = %s for the primary currency, but the primary currency takes this setting from %s, where %s = %s applies. Make the two agree, or remove %s from %s, to silence this warning.
economy.log.wallet_merge.too_large: Primary-currency wallet merge: adding %s cash and %s bank from %s's second wallet would take their account beyond the largest amount this server can store, so nothing was moved; the second wallet stays in currency_balances for an operator to settle.
